nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) tracking each investor's deposited amount; drives ROI calculation.
mapping(address=>uint256) storing the timestamp when an investor joined/last withdrew; ROI accrues from it.
mapping(address=>uint256) holding accumulated referral (bounty) funds per address.
uint256 public step = 2400, used inside getBalance ROI percent math.
uint256 public minimum = 10 finney, minimum accepted investment and bounty threshold.
uint256 public maximum = 5 ether, maximum accepted investment.
uint256 public stakingRequirement = 0.5 ether, referral staking gate.
address public ownerWallet receiving the 5% fee on each buy; updated in transferOwnership.
address public owner, access-control authority checked by onlyOwner.
constructor() sets owner and ownerWallet from msg.sender.
public onlyOwner function that reassigns owner and ownerWallet.
payable fallback function that forwards incoming ether to buy(0x0).
public payable buy(address) recording investment, paying referral and 5% owner fee, timestamping join.
view function computing accrued ROI balance for an address using now and investments math.
public function computing balance via getBalance and transferring it to msg.sender.
public function paying referral earnings to msg.sender.
view helper returning getBalance(msg.sender).
view helper returning investments[_investor].
view helper returning referrer[_hunter].
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, investment accounting and every ether transfer.
Block timestamp (now) used to timestamp joins and to derive ROI multipliers/minutes counted.
ownerWallet.transfer(msg.value.mul(5).div(100)) inside buy sends ether to a state-controlled address.
msg.sender.transfer(balance) inside withdraw sends ether to an untrusted caller.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) inside withdraw drains whole contract balance to caller.
msg.sender.transfer(refBalance) inside bounty sends referral funds to an untrusted caller.
Unchecked raw multiplications/accumulations (percent * i, 2**x, balance +=) in getBalance without SafeMath.
buy() parameter: referrer address credited with 5% redistribution when staking requirement is met.
transferOwnership() parameter assigned to owner after zero-address check.
transferOwnership() parameter assigned to ownerWallet.
getBalance() parameter, address whose ROI balance is computed.
checkInvestments() parameter used to index the investments mapping.
checkReferral() parameter used to index the referrer mapping.
buy() local holding msg.sender, used for self-referral prevention.
getBalance() local: now.sub(joined[_address]).div(1 minutes).
getBalance() local: 2**(minutesCount / 60) ROI doubling multiplier.
getBalance() local: investments.mul(step).div(1000) * multiplier.
getBalance() local accumulator returned as the user's accrued balance.
getBalance() loop index i*=2 iterating ROI tier multipliers.
bounty() local: checkReferral(msg.sender) amount to be transferred.
withdraw() local: getBalance(msg.sender) amount transferred to the caller.

edges.reason: constructor reads msg.sender to initialize owner and ownerWallet.
msg.sender is written into the privileged owner state variable (constructor and transferOwnership).
msg.sender is written into ownerWallet which receives the 5% fee on every buy.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender's investments/joined entries are created and msg.value is taken in buy.
buy() calls withdraw() for an existing investor, letting the caller trigger a payout.
_customerAddress local is assigned msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed to getBalance from withdraw and checkBalance.
msg.sender is passed to checkReferral inside bounty.
untrusted caller address receives ether via msg.sender.transfer(balance) in withdraw.
untrusted caller address receives address(this).balance in the else branch of withdraw.
untrusted caller address receives referral ether via msg.sender.transfer(refBalance) in bounty.
bounty resets referrer[msg.sender] to zero before/while paying out.
joined[msg.sender] is set to block.timestamp in buy and reset in withdraw, making accrual timestamp dependent.
minutesCount is derived from now (block.timestamp) minus joined, so ROI is timestamp dependent.
_referredBy indexes the referrer mapping credited with 5% of msg.value.
_referredBy's investments are compared against stakingRequirement for the referral gate.
joined[_address] is read inside getBalance to compute elapsed minutes.
investments[_address] is the principal used to compute percent in getBalance.
state variable step (2400) multiplies investments when computing percent.
withdraw stores getBalance(msg.sender) into its balance local.
getBalance accumulates and returns its balance local.
unchecked accumulation balance += percent(...) can overflow uint256 outside SafeMath.
unchecked raw multiplication percent * userROIMultiplier can overflow.
userROIMultiplier = 2**(minutesCount/60) can overflow for large elapsed times.
loop index i multiplies percent for each ROI tier.
withdraw's balance local is the exact amount transferred to msg.sender.
withdraw's balance local drives the full-contract-balance payout in the else branch.
bounty's refBalance local is transferred to msg.sender.
buy requires msg.value >= minimum.
buy requires msg.value <= maximum.
payable fallback forwards received ether into buy(0x0).
withdraw calls getBalance(msg.sender) to size the payout.
bounty calls checkReferral(msg.sender) to size the payout.
checkBalance calls getBalance(msg.sender).
transferOwnership assigns the newOwner parameter to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership assigns the newOwnerWallet parameter to ownerWallet.
ownerWallet (state-controlled address) is the recipient of the 5% fee transfer in buy.
buy executes ownerWallet.transfer(msg.value.mul(5).div(100)).
getBalance performs raw unchecked multiplications and additions on user funds math.
bounty requires refBalance >= minimum before paying out.
buy increments investments[msg.sender] with msg.value.
bounty zeroes referrer[msg.sender] after payout.
